text.t:
Make this Christmas even more special with personalised magnets, lovingly created to cherish the most beautiful moments of this magical season.
With a special photograph, a child's name, a personalised message or simply a Merry Christmas, each piece is a unique keepsake, perfect for giving to family, friends, teachers or anyone who makes our lives more beautiful.

options.names.help.t: The photograph is sent after the order: simply reply to the confirmation email with it.

gpsr.warnings.0.t: Contains magnets. Keep them out of the reach of children: if a child swallows a magnet, get medical help at once.
